preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200.
For each test case, the number of special nodes K must be at least 1 and at most N, where N is the number of nodes in the tree.
The node a must be a valid node in the tree, numbered from 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f_i <= N for f_i in f)
preconditions.description: All special nodes f_i must be valid nodes in the tree, numbered from 1 to N.
All special nodes must be distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= N and 1 <= v_i <= N for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes in the tree.
The total number of nodes across all test cases must not exceed 400,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly 2 lines for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdout.splitlines()[::2])
postconditions.description: Each line of maximum values must contain exactly N integers.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdout.splitlines()[1::2])
postconditions.description: Each line of special nodes must contain exactly N integers.

postconditions.expression: all(int(max_values[i]) == max(d(a, u) - d(i, u) for u in f) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The maximum values must be correctly calculated for each node i.

postconditions.expression: all(int(special_nodes[i]) in f for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The special nodes must be valid special nodes from the input.
